```python
if not (self.password):
    _add(':')
    _add(quote_userinfo_part(self.password))
```

This added `:password` only when there was NO password present (passing `None` to `quote_userinfo_part`), and omitted the `:password` segment when a password actually existed — exactly backwards. Fixed by negating the condition to `if self.password:`, so the `:password` segment is appended only when a password is actually present.

Verified:
- `URL('http://wiki:underpass@hatnote.com').to_text()` → `'http://wiki:underpass@hatnote.com'` (roundtrip correct)
- `URL('http://wiki@hatnote.com').to_text()` → `'http://wiki@hatnote.com'` (no stray colon, bare username)

- `URL('http://wiki@hatnote.com').to_text()` → `'http://wiki@hatnote.com'` (no stray colon, bare username)
